subgroup stream header with Type 0x16, whose SUBGROUP_ID_MODE is the reserved 0b11 — must close the session. Section 10.4.2: "The following Type values are invalid. If an endpoint receives a stream header with any of these Type values, it MUST close the session with a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION: Type values with SUBGROUP_ID_MODE set to 0b11: 0x16, 0x17, 0x1E, 0x1F, 0x36, 0x37, 0x3E, 0x3F. This mode is reserved for future use." Distinct from a Type outside the defined form, which no table assigns at all; this one is inside the form and separately named invalid. The bytes after the Type are those of the subgroup-single-object vector, which decodes.
vectors.error_detail: subgroup stream Type 0x16 sets SUBGROUP_ID_MODE to the reserved 0b11

vectors.description: subgroup stream header with Type 0x20, whose bit 4 is clear. Section 10.4.2: "Type values that do not match the form 0b00X1XXXX (i.e., Type values outside the ranges 0x10..0x1F and 0x30..0x3F, or values where bit 4 is not set)." Bit 4 is the one bit every SUBGROUP_HEADER Type sets, so a value without it names no stream this draft assigns, and Section 3.4 is the rule that answers it: "An endpoint that receives an unknown stream type MUST close the session." Draft-20 states bit 4 as a condition on a flags field instead and answers the same byte with invalid_type. The bytes after the Type are those of the subgroup-single-object vector, which decodes.
vectors.error_detail: stream Type 0x20 has bit 4 clear and is assigned to nothing

vectors.description: subgroup stream header whose Type decodes to 144, encoded as the minimal two-byte varint 8090. Section 10.4.2: "Type values that do not match the form 0b00X1XXXX (i.e., Type values outside the ranges 0x10..0x1F and 0x30..0x3F, or values where bit 4 is not set)." Bit 4 is set and SUBGROUP_ID_MODE is 0b00, so the value clears every condition but the form's leading zero, and bit 7 is what puts it outside. Every Type the form admits is below 0x80 and occupies one byte; the width is refused before the value, because narrowing a two-byte field to its low octet would read this as 0x90 and a 0x8010 as an ordinary subgroup header. The bytes after the Type are those of the subgroup-single-object vector, which decodes.
vectors.error_detail: stream Type 144 is outside the form the draft defines

vectors.description: subgroup stream header with Type 0x50, whose bit 6 is set. Section 10.4.2: "Type values that do not match the form 0b00X1XXXX (i.e., Type values outside the ranges 0x10..0x1F and 0x30..0x3F, or values where bit 4 is not set)." Draft-17 fixes bits 6 and 7 at zero, so 0x50 is outside the form and names no stream this draft assigns. Draft-18 widened the form to 0b0XX1XXXX and gave bit 6 to FIRST_OBJECT, and these exact bytes are its subgroup-first-object-bit vector, which decodes there and on every draft after it. The same nine bytes are a conforming stream on one draft and a session close on the one before it.
vectors.error_detail: stream Type 0x50 sets bit 6, which draft-17 leaves clear
